name: Trance2
description: Trance drums plus a rolling bassline. Hold to gate — hits lock to the host beat. Classic four-on-the-floor 909 kit with offbeat opens. X grows bass complexity (offbeat 1/8 → rolling 16ths → walks). Y thickens drums toward Fill. Flick top-right for a one-bar Fill. Default ~138 BPM.

params.name: BASS
params.detail: Bassline complexity: offbeat eighths → rolling 16ths → root walks

params.name: DRUM
params.detail: Drum complexity: hat density and clap-roll build toward Fill

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Kit + bass level (Audio In always full)
